verdict.rationale: The only natural-language feature in the evidence is an AI virtual assistant that answers payroll and HR questions. That is Q&A support, not a way to operate the product (running payroll, changing employee records) through natural-language commands. ADP Assist for API Central is a developer tool for finding APIs and generating code samples, not a natural-language way to operate RUN, so neither feature earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Powered by AI, the virtual assistant instantly answers your business’s payroll and HR questions.
